title: 5th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/3/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the names of candidates who applied in response to the Parliament Secretariat's announcement for appointing 3 members to the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Commission under Article 17(a)(1) of Law No. 16/2025 (Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Act) are sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the Human Organ Transplantation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Feydhoo South MP Ibrahim Didi.

Continued debate on the resolution submitted by Madaveli MP Mohamed Shameez calling for the corruption flagged in the Auditor General's special audit report on Fenaka Corporation Limited to be investigated and acted on quickly.
Continued debate on Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's bill amending Law No. 4/2007 (Audit Act).
Continued debate on Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's bill amending Law No. 3/2013 (Privatization, Corporatization, Monitoring and Evaluation of State Enterprises Act).

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's submission to appoint 4 members to the National Integrity Commission under Article 11 of Law No. 27/2015 (National Integrity Commission Act).
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission to appoint non-resident ambassadors to the Republic of Kazakhstan and the Republic of Mauritius.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's request for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to accept and ratify the "Instrument for the Acceptance of the 1986 Constitutional Amendment".
Report of the General Committee on the Speaker's proposal to amend Article 61 of Parliament's Standing Orders to set a dress code for members at sittings.

Report of the General Committee on the Speaker's proposal to add a new chapter after Chapter 51 of the Standing Orders setting out how Parliament proceeds when it decides, or is required, to hold a public referendum.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent Media Commission applicants to committee, introduced the organ transplant bill, continued the Fenaka, Audit Act and privatization debates, and took five committee reports on appointments, a treaty instrument and Standing Orders changes.
